scope: Common measured 40 N.s lateral prescribed body wrench, normalized half-sine over 80 ms; declared URDF inertials and torque-bounded feedback. Human animation is visual only; no human contact, all-direction recovery, or hardware qualification claim.

controller.load_trim_constraint: zero sum across FL/FR/RL/RR, bounded per leg
controller.motor_gain_model: ForceBased implicit PD; gains have N m units
controller.stance_strategy: same wider joint stance for feedback and ablation; gravity and source geometry determine settled height
